newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber ends sharply lower, July down limit.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber ends sharply lower, July down limit.

text.p: CME lumber futures closed sharply lower with July ending down the $10.00 per thousand board feet (tbf) limit.
Traders said much of the selling was keyed to fund selling that developed when July moved under $387.20 per tbf.
Cash lumber markets were quiet but cash spruce prices were quoted lower last week by lumber market sources.
CME lumber closed down $10.00 to up $2.10 with July off the most at $382.60. Gains were limited to the thinly traded deferred contracts.
